input.quote: 24.4 Customer's change of control does not give Vendor a right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service. Vendor shall cooperate with reasonable administrative changes needed to reflect a permitted successor.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets the preferred position. 24.1 lets Customer assign to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets without Vendor's consent (notice only). 24.2 bars Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without Customer's prior written consent, not to be unreasonably withheld, and bars assignment to a direct Customer competitor. 24.3 applies a mutual not-unreasonably-withheld consent standard to other assignments. 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any termination, suspension, repricing, acceleration, or service-reduction right on Customer's change of control, and no other clause (searched "change of control" and "assign" across the document, including § 9 Termination and § 30 General) creates such a right; § 13.5 also confirms Customer may transfer licence rights to an Affiliate or successor. The only wording short of preferred is that the competitor bar in 24.2 is framed as "without Customer's consent" rather than absolute — a minor sub-element noted rather than redlined, since the gate remains Customer's own consent.
